Container.Name: Media-AI-Model-Server
Container.Overview: AI-powered tagging server for a local image, video and audio library. It receives media paths (normally under /media) and returns time-based tags, face detections and embeddings that clients such as Cove or Stash can use to organise and search a library. This template runs the NVIDIA CUDA image, which is tuned for a Tesla M40 24GB (sm_52, CUDA 12.6 wheels). Install the Nvidia-Driver plugin and expose a GPU to the container; a CUDA-capable NVIDIA GPU with 8GB+ VRAM is recommended. The image does not include any AI models: download the free or paid models from the project wiki and copy their config and models folders into the mounted Config and Models paths, then set the active model in config/active_ai.yaml. The HTTP API listens on port 8000, with interactive API docs (Swagger UI) at /docs.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: ai tagging nsfw cove stash media
Container.Requires: NVIDIA GPU with the Nvidia-Driver plugin installed; 8GB+ VRAM recommended. AI models are not included and must be downloaded separately.

Config.Name: API Port
Config.Description: HTTP API and Swagger UI port (http://[IP]:[PORT:8000]/docs).

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Persistent configuration: active model selection, pipelines and downloaded model YAMLs.

Config.Name: Models
Config.Description: Downloaded AI model files and any .lic license files.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Media library. Paths sent to the API must resolve here (e.g. /media/movies/a.mp4).

Config.Name: NVIDIA Visible Devices
Config.Description: GPUs exposed to the container. Use 'all' or a specific GPU UUID.

Config.Name: NVIDIA Driver Capabilities
Config.Description: compute and utility for CUDA, video for NVDEC hardware decoding.
